digest.component_or_area: ticket store push logging (push_classify, push_recovery, push_state)
propositions: Expected and auto-handled push failures due to concurrent-writer contention are surfaced at WARNING level with raw git error messages that prime LLM agents to investigate non-issues, wasting tokens on hallucinated outage diagnostics.

Mid-retry transient transport faults and ordinary unpushed-commit backlogs are logged at INFO/WARNING despite being routine self-healing conditions under normal concurrent load, not operator-actionable outage signals.
Backlog summary messages emit bare '..HEAD' tokens and lack explicit self-healing contract language, causing sessions to misinterpret local commit state as potential corruption.

Policy declines (hook rejection, branch protection), strict-mode delivery failures, and proven-growing backlogs must remain operator-loud (WARNING/raise); routine contention losses and transient retries must be demoted to DEBUG or suppressed entirely from agent-visible output.

Logging demotion (INFO→DEBUG for expected cases, new _terminal_severity helper, backlog_grew comparison, explicit 'origin/tickets' branch naming, self-healing contract in message text) is required without behavior or retry logic changes.
